reviewBoundary: Human-readable review of actual generated source plus independent causal browser receipts; not model-authored test claims

findings: drawCube draws a two-dimensional rectangle, without projected 3D vertices
z is passed as an ignored extra argument to Canvas2D translate/scale
position and scale controls have no listeners
drawing uses a global cube instead of each requested scene object
draw uses only four same-z vertices; project screen x/y never depend on z
position and scale inputs have no listeners; no Delete control or wheel handler
const selectedCube is reassigned on mouse events and causes TypeError
full-viewport canvas and overflow:hidden hide following controls

limits: Explicit evaluation prompt requested offline real projected vertices and working controls, stronger and more specific than the original vague request
Browser pixel changes alone cannot establish genuine 3D geometry
Earlier animation-confounded browser v1 is superseded by causal paired-page v2
No generated artifact is represented as a working modeler or a production improvement
